fetches.source_authority: California State Assembly, Office of the Chief Clerk — official archive of California session laws
fetches.content_description: Complete scanned PDF of Volume 1 of Statutes and Amendments to the Codes, Forty-Eighth Session of the California Legislature, 1929 Regular Session. Contains all chapters of the regular session including Chapter 791 (the Contractors State License Law) at printed pages 1591–1595 (PDF pages 1593–1597). Image-based PDF with no OCR text layer.

fetches.source_authority: California State Assembly, Office of the Chief Clerk
fetches.content_description: Index volume covering printed pages ~2279 onward. Contains the CONTRACTORS entry pointing to printed page 1591 ('licensing, registration and regulation of') which is where Chapter 791 begins.

fetches.derivation_method: pdftoppm -f 1593 -l 1593 -r 150 -png
fetches.content_description: First page of Chapter 791. Shows: 'CHAPTER 791.', the full title verbatim, the approval line '[Approved by the Governor June 13, 1929. In effect August 14, 1929.]', the formula 'The people of the State of California do enact as follows:', Section 1 (license-required clause), and the beginning of Section 2 (exemptions list).

fetches.derivation_method: pdftoppm -f 1594 -l 1594 -r 150 -png
fetches.content_description: Second page of Chapter 791. Shows: Section 2 continued (exemptions (b)-(f)), Section 3 (contractor defined — including the inclusion of subcontractors and the exclusion of mere materials suppliers), Section 4 (Director of Department of Professional and Vocational Standards constituted as Registrar), Section 5 (application for license, fee, license fund creation).

fetches.derivation_method: pdftoppm -f 1595 -l 1595 -r 150 -png
fetches.content_description: Third page of Chapter 791. Shows: Section 5 conclusion, Section 6 (issuance of license — 10-day duty), Section 7 (expiration June 30 each year, renewal procedure), Section 8 (registrar's records, public inspection, certified copies).

fetches.derivation_method: pdftoppm -f 1596 -l 1596 -r 150 -png
fetches.content_description: Fourth page of Chapter 791. Shows: Section 8 conclusion, Section 9 (complaints and grounds for filing — abandonment, diversion of funds, fraudulent departure from plans, wilful injurious acts), Section 10 (investigation and rehearing procedure).

fetches.derivation_method: pdftoppm -f 1597 -l 1597 -r 150 -png
fetches.content_description: Fifth and final page of Chapter 791. Shows: Section 11 (renewal after suspension), Section 12 (penalties — up to $500 fine and/or six months imprisonment), Section 13 (constitutionality severance), Section 14 (general repealer). Chapter 792 begins immediately after on the next page, providing a clean boundary marker.

session_appendices.session_note: Evolution-layer + current-layer build. Added 1931 Ch.578, 1933 Ch.573, and 1935 Ch.816 as evolution artifacts (the full amendment chain from original 1929 enactment to creation of CSLB), plus current-form leginfo URLs for B&P Code §§ 7000+ as the modern codified location.
